## Validation and readiness

The three active sources are fetch-verified; two inaccessible Atiyah–Bott sources retain their six-attempt histories and documented alternatives. The inspected sources distinguish the general groupoid proof route from BGV’s Dirac-type local calculation and Heitsch’s abbreviated final calculation. ([Yi](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2003.00955), [BGV](https://djvu.online/file/ruwkno3rtNaI5), [Heitsch](https://homepages.math.uic.edu/~heitsch/HeitschBC.pdf))

All five Step 1 records are **escalated**. The page predecessor `qftx-borel-localization` has no current carrier, and the local heat-kernel convergence, domination, and off-fixed-set estimates remain unproved for the general class stated. No item is marked ready.

The batch 10 item levels recompute cleanly as 0, 1, 2, 1, 1; its batch level is 2 and requires batch 8. The run-wide item-level check still fails on empty inventories and stale levels in other batches, and the persisted run-wide batch-level snapshot is stale. Those owner-controlled scheduling files were left unchanged; details are in the batch notes.
